description: Guatemala's National Statistics Institute publishes on its CKAN open data portal the 2018 Population and Housing Census aggregated to every populated place (lugar poblado), about 20,000 localities, together with a file of their centroid coordinates. Each workbook has sheets by department, municipality and populated place. Household tables cover the main source of drinking water, sanitation, type of lighting and cooking energy, household equipment, waste disposal, rooms and tenure; dwelling tables cover type, occupancy and the materials of walls, roof and floor; population tables include use of mobile phones, computers and the internet. Coverage is national: of 3,275,931 households, 2,887,256 were lit from the electricity grid and 101,237 by solar or wind panels, and 1,782,861 cooked mainly with firewood. The dataset also links household, dwelling and person CSV bases hosted on a cloud drive. Format and access: free XLSX downloads and a CKAN API, no registration. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution as tagged on the dataset. Caveats: the linked CSV bases sit on an external file share that was not opened; the INE main site and the census microsite blocked the cloud (bot check and connection resets). Simulation uses: locality level electrification, water and sanitation gaps with point locations for network planning, and dwelling materials for earthquake and flood exposure. Related records: the 510 AI building footprints for southern Guatemala.
